idea-plugin.name: Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with Claude from inside Rider.
  • Tool window with conversation history
  • Send the current file or selection as context
  • Cursor position and file path are auto-attached
  • Model and API key configured in Settings → Tools → Claude AI Assistant
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.19.0

  • Pending attachments (image thumbnails / file chips) now appear ABOVE the input box instead of below. The input and action row stay anchored to the bottom, so adding attachments no longer shifts the input position.
  • Ctrl+V image paste now actually works. Switched from a keymap binding (which IntelliJ's IdeKeyEventDispatcher was intercepting) to overriding JBTextArea.paste() directly - this catches paste no matter how the IDE routes the keystroke.

0.18.4

  • Inline code (text in `backticks`) now renders with red text on a light pink background instead of the dark Darcula look, matching common documentation styling.

0.18.3

  • Fix the "response cuts off after a few characters" bug. Root cause was a NullPointerException inside Swing's HTML CSS parser when rendering markdown output: properties like border-radius, white-space:pre-wrap, max-height and four-value margin shorthand aren't supported by JTextPane's CSS, and at least one of them was tripping CSS.getInternalCSSValue when parsing the assistant's heading bubble - causing insertHTML to abort partway through. The visible "Overview of" / "I see you're in the" cutoffs were the prefix that did make it in before the parser blew up. All rendered styles now use only HTML 3.2-compatible CSS (single-value margin/padding, no border-radius, no max-height, no white-space).

0.18.2

  • Rewrote the SSE parser to follow the spec: accumulate "data:" lines into a buffer and dispatch one event per blank line, instead of treating each line as its own event. Also strips SSE comment lines and the optional single leading space after "data:". This fixes a class of responses being cut off when Anthropic split a single event across multiple data: lines.
  • Stream events get logged to idea.log: event count, total text length, stop reason, plus a warning dump when a short response ends with no stop reason. Useful for diagnosing further "cut off" reports.

0.18.1

  • Stream-end note is now always shown. A subtle gray "(end_turn)" / "(stop_sequence)" / "(tool_use)" tag confirms a response completed normally; amber "(max_tokens ...)" / "(stream ended unexpectedly ...)" still flag abnormal endings. Replies that look truncated mid-thought but were actually end_turn are now obvious instead of mysterious.

0.18.0

  • User chat bubbles get a subtle gray underlay so you can tell at a glance which text you wrote and which Claude wrote. Picks a darker tint on light themes and a lighter tint on dark themes from the transcript's actual background.
